package-inspection.scope: Host inspecting a package before activation
package-inspection.expect: Discover data-only and executable packages, verify their declared entries and reject duplicate exports.
package-inspection.qualification: Publisher identity and confinement require deployment evidence.

distribution.scope: Author and receiving host using a local archive
distribution.expect: Produce identical verified archives from identical input. Reject tampered or unsafe members and preserve the prior artifact after a failed update.

scoped-binding.expect: Bind one exact compatible export and scope. Reject a missing peer, colliding identity or ambiguous binding.
scoped-binding.qualification: Required activation cycles and unrelated optional failures need an implementing host.

schema-boundary.scope: Host admitting a package or accepting a reply
schema-boundary.expect: Resolve distributed schemas offline and validate a response before exposing its data.

wire-values.scope: Caller and executor exchanging portable JSON
wire-values.expect: Accept valid scalar values and refuse ambiguous encoding, duplicate keys, unsafe magnitudes, invalid dates and contract versions.

wire-errors.expect: Return an attributable error for an invalid envelope or unknown method. An unnegotiated notification produces no reply or effect.

negotiated-session.scope: Core caller and executor selecting a session and revision
negotiated-session.expect: Select a mutually supported version and verify the admitted descriptor. Refuse mandatory unknown features, stale pins and invalid call metadata.

status-call.scope: Python and Go implementations of a local resource read
status-call.expect: Return the authorized resource, refuse invalid or ungranted input and accept a later valid call on the same negotiated session.

wire-budgets.scope: Caller and executor applying a deadline or a frame limit
wire-budgets.expect: Reject an expired or malformed deadline and bound the work and bytes accepted at each hop.
wire-budgets.qualification: Qualify maximum frame size, backpressure and time spent in queues for each claimed transport.

peer-authority.scope: Independently owned hosts using a scoped peer binding
peer-authority.expect: A read succeeds on the selected peer. The wrong credential, wrong resource or proposed write under a read grant is refused.
peer-authority.qualification: The fixture uses loopback. Remote identity, revocation lag and transitive delegation require their own deployment checks.

peer-loss.scope: Standalone host losing an optional peer
peer-loss.expect: The authorized local read remains available after the peer stops.
peer-loss.qualification: Check reconciliation and authority expiry during an actual partition.

approved-effect.scope: Account owner spending one synthetic reset credit
approved-effect.expect: Preparation leaves the balance intact. Commit requires the exact intent, current authorization and unexpired preconditions.

recover-effect.scope: Account owner reconnecting after a lost acknowledgement
recover-effect.expect: A duplicate or competing commit cannot consume the same credit twice. Reopen the local ledger and read the durable outcome.
recover-effect.qualification: Recovery of an unknown external effect requires evidence from its authority.

agent-dialogue.scope: Two processes exchanging native agent messages
agent-dialogue.expect: Clarify, return and confirm a scoped fact within a bounded conversation. Reject conflicting delivery, excess budget, unauthorized input or an unsupported required modality.
agent-dialogue.qualification: Model quality, cross-machine delivery and billed inference need a named deployment.

artifact-read.scope: Recipient reading a scoped, versioned artifact
artifact-read.expect: Read bounded byte ranges and verify the length and digest of the reassembled data.
artifact-read.qualification: Authorize ranges and enforce expiry on the deployed reader.

account-inventory.scope: Client viewing accounts for one provider and product
account-inventory.expect: Keep complete and partial inventories distinct and preserve the origin of each account observation.
account-inventory.qualification: Verify sign-in, renewal, effective route and attribution with the selected provider.

quota-and-price.scope: Client interpreting a quota, reset grant or plan price
quota-and-price.expect: Distinguish zero, unknown and contract pricing. An empty reset grant cannot claim eligibility.
quota-and-price.qualification: Measure freshness, shared-pool aggregation and actual charges at the source.

catalog-change.scope: Client comparing complete and partial model catalogs
catalog-change.expect: Retain evidence for incomplete pages and require an official source for an end-of-life notice.
catalog-change.qualification: Exercise live changes to model identity, entitlement and parameter support.

model-invocation.scope: Adapter serving an explicitly selected account, route, model and mode
model-invocation.expect: Attribute the actual reply and reject silent substitution.
model-invocation.qualification: Qualify each supported mode and parameter combination against its real endpoint.

surface-actions.scope: Host rendering a surface for a person or agent
surface-actions.expect: Render validated state and bind actions to the same public operation and authority as the programmatic interface.
surface-actions.qualification: Test keyboard and assistive operation, stale generations, isolation and failure on each client.

extension-evolution.scope: Independent author adding a capability or adapting existing software
extension-evolution.expect: Expose optional features through versioned contracts, reject unsupported mandatory semantics and preserve the guarantees of existing bindings.
extension-evolution.qualification: Demonstrate essential behavior with independent consumers before requiring it in Core.

edition-compatibility.scope: Maintainer or agent changing a supported contract
edition-compatibility.expect: Keep rule and scenario identities traceable and exercise the published client expectations against the candidate and the candidate hosts against the published package.
edition-compatibility.qualification: Edition replay covers the declared reference fixtures. Additional deployments and profiles need their own evidence.

instance-lifecycle.scope: Host draining an instance, hook or surface
instance-lifecycle.expect: Revocation prevents new dispatch. Retired generations release resources and cannot act on current state.
instance-lifecycle.qualification: Exercise disablement, crash, hook reentry and replacement on a lifecycle implementation.

operational-evidence.scope: Operator interpreting health, conformance or usage
operational-evidence.expect: Attribute observations to the actual target, scope, revision and time, distinguish probes from work and preserve evidence gaps.
operational-evidence.qualification: Verify aggregation, confidentiality, retention and actual support in the reporting deployment.

stream-delivery.scope: Producer and slow consumer on a negotiated stream
stream-delivery.expect: Enforce credit, ordered progress, cancellation and one terminal outcome.
stream-delivery.qualification: Exercise a real stream binding across slow consumers, reconnects and sequence gaps.

event-delivery.expect: Deduplicate identical delivery and expose a gap when retained history is insufficient.
event-delivery.qualification: Only the event record is exercised. Qualify acknowledgement, ordering and replay on the selected event binding.

durable-job.scope: Job owner handling continuation, cancellation or restart
durable-job.expect: Resume from the owned revision, preserve effects and prevent a terminal job from reopening.
durable-job.qualification: The waiting-job record is exercised. Qualify crash recovery and competing continuations on the job implementation.

cloud-resource.scope: Tenant observing a product lifecycle across owners
cloud-resource.expect: Attribute an authoritative state, condition and revision to the resource. Preserve recovery and ownership across placement changes.
cloud-resource.qualification: Qualify provisioning, residency, durability and tenant isolation on the deployed service.

native-binding.scope: Platform owner admitting a native component
native-binding.expect: A hard timing claim includes a qualified worst-case bound, a target interface and a recovery path.
native-binding.qualification: Validate ABI, handle lifetime and timing on the named platform.

capacity-and-recovery.scope: Independent cells, tenants and a constrained native path
capacity-and-recovery.expect: Bound resource use and demonstrate recovery and timing for a named workload and failure domain.
capacity-and-recovery.qualification: Measure throughput, queue growth, latency and recovery under the declared load and loss of a cell.

service-obligations.scope: Operator of a metered or commercial service
service-obligations.expect: Maintain accountable terms, ownership, retention and idempotent meter attribution across upgrades and recovery.
service-obligations.qualification: Verify metering, billing, support and continuity against the actual offering.
